The wall

The line between the world and the supplier. Only what a real GB supplier could receive crosses it — meter reads, market data, payments, industry messages, regulation. The test on every line of supplier code: could a real supplier know this?

Read each column top to bottom as a list, not a chain. Each box carries its state, read from the maturity map at publish: Live built and at target, Building under way, Planned not started.

Where to see it working

  • Capabilities — what the company does with each flow that crosses.
  • How it’s built — the verifier and the rules that keep the wall shut.
  • Explore — one household as the company sees it.
  • The code — the seam itself, and the adapters on it.
